checked_obligation: Under the assumption that the list total exceeds 210, prove that some subset sum lies in [190,210].

counterexample.target: The universal Case 2 assertion that every admissible list of total greater than 210 has a subset sum in [190,210].
counterexample.witness: Take the ordered list (25,25,25,25,23,22,22,22,22), whose total is 211. Its first eight terms sum to 189 and all nine sum to 211. Every proper subset omits an element of size at least 22, so its sum is at most 211-22=189; the full subset sums to 211. Hence no subset sum lies in [190,210].

reason: The deletion assertion is false. For the listed counterexample, the first partial sum exceeding 190 is 211, but deleting any element lowers it to at most 189. More generally, every proper subset has sum at most 189, while the full set has sum 211. The supplied group and ring results are inapplicable to this subset-sum claim.
